title: DSWD boosts relief storage, food aid in Eastern Samar

blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY—The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) expanded its relief storage capacity in Eastern Visayas, providing community kitchen equipment to three Eastern Samar towns to strengthen disaster response and food assistance for affected families. The DSWD carried out the initiatives on Monday and inaugurated a1,200-square-meter extension of the agency’s Regional Resource Operations Center
